Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 1.1: Replying to a Friend About Your New House and Big Garden
Nội dung chi tiết:
You have received an email from your English-speaking friend asking about the new house you recently moved into. Read part of the email below:

"Congratulations on moving into your new home! I would love to hear all about it. Where is your new house located, and what is the neighborhood like? I heard it even has a large garden—what do you plan to do with that space? Write back soon!"

Write an informal email responding to your friend.

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.1: Parental Pressure via Social Media on Teachers: Effects and Solutions
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"Nowadays, many parents frequently share stories and opinions about school and education issues on social media platforms. Education experts warn that teachers are facing greater pressure than ever before, which can strain the relationship between schools, families, and local communities."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the effects of this trend and proposing practical solutions to strengthen cooperation between communities, teachers, and parents. Support your arguments with specific reasons and examples.
